question: How long was the Second Great War in StarCraft Lore (in years, rounded up)

5.text: PUBLIC RESPONSE: I’d answer 2 years. The Second Great War is generally dated from the zerg resurgence and the opening of the StarCraft II-era conflict in 2504 through the fall of the Dominion/end of Kerrigan’s campaign in 2505. Since it runs from one calendar year into the next, it spans 2504 and 2505, so when rounding up to whole years I’d count it as 2 years.

3.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: In-universe the conflict that Blizzard / the Dominion historiography calls the Second Great War is the Koprulu-wide Terran–Zerg–Protoss war that opens with the Dominion’s resumption of hostilities against Kerrigan’s Swarm after Brood War and closes with the End War / the defeat of Amon in the Legacy of the Void campaign.

Chronologically it is placed

* c. 2504  – the opening Dominion / Raynor actions on Mar Sara / Korhal that the Dominion proclaims the Second Great War, essentially the start of the StarCraft II: Wings of Liberty era; and
* c. 2509  – the final End War / the destruction of Amon and the dissolution of Kerrigan’s Swarm as a belligerent in Legacy of the Void.

2509 – 2504 ≈ 5 yr of open Great-War level hostilities, about four-and-a-half to five calendar years in the source material, i.e. ≈5 yr, effectively ~4-5 yr depending on inclusive counting, commonly rounded up to five years of war.

8.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: In Koprulu canon the war that is usually called the Second Great War / Second Terran-Zerg War is the Brood War era conflict that follows the StarCraft I First War.

Canon dating is deliberately loose, but the in-universe chronology that is normally quoted is:

* the opening Zerg offensives against the new Terran Dominion / the resurgence of the Brood in the Koprulu Sector ~ mid-late 2502,
* the closing action the Battle of Char / the destruction of the Overmind and the end of the Dominion-Zerg hot war ~ early 2504, with the UED aftermath settling in 2505.

That is an in-universe span of roughly 15-18 months, i.e. about one year and some months of active campaigning.  Rounded up to whole years that is the ~2 yr figure that is conventionally quoted for the Second Great War, often simply stated as 2502-2504. 

If the years are counted inclusively 2502-2504 the interval is quoted as a three calendar-year war. The commonly used rounded-up operational length is ~2 years.

PUBLIC RESPONSE: In-universe the “Second Great War” is the name that is normally used for the Brood War / Terran-Dominion vs Zerg phase that follows the events of the first StarCraft campaign.

In canon the whole Brood-War phase is placed essentially inside the 2501-2502 / 2503-2504 window of the Koprulu chronology. The death of the Overmind that sparks the inter-brood fighting and the UED / Dominion counter-offensive is dated to late 2501/early 2503 and the consolidation of Kerrigan’s Queen of Blades hegemony that is taken as the effective close of the war is dated to late 2502/early 2504. That is on the order of ~ 9-18 months of in-universe elapsed time, i.e. about one calendar year of fighting.

Rounded to whole years that is ≈ 1 yr of actual elapsed time, ≈ 2 yr on a conventional round-up. Most fan / wiki timelines quote the war as a ~1-yr ~1.5-yr conflict, hence the usual round-up figure quoted is 2 years.

Canonical chronology puts the opening of that phase in 2504 with the first Dominion–Zerg / Kerrigan power struggles after the Overmind’s death and the close of the phase with the Battle of Char / the end of the Brood War campaign in 2507.

2507 − 2504 ≈ 3 y in-universe, c. 3 y 6–10 m depending on the month you take for the start/end. That is the ~ three-year war that is usually quoted for the Second Great War/Brood War.

If you round any partial calendar year up, 2504→2507 is four calendar years of in-universe time.

PRIVATE REFLECTION: The question hinges on which in-universe conflict is being named the “Second Great War”. Colleagues split between two canonical framings:

* Brood War framing = Second Great War. Dates cited: ~mid-late 2500/2502/2503 → 2501/2502/2504/2505. Elapsed in-universe ~15-18 mo to ~1.5-2 yr. Most Brood-War proponents round up to 2 yr, with a few citing inclusive calendar book-ends 2502-2504/2503-2505 as ~3 calendar years. Common shorthand: ~1 yr active → 2 yr rounded up.

* StarCraft II era framing = Second Great War. Dates cited: start ~2504 with Wings of Liberty / Dominion-Zerg resurgence after Overmind’s death, end ~2505 with Mengsk’s fall / 2506-2507 with Battle of Char/UED withdrawal / 2509 with End War vs Amon in Legacy of the Void. Elapsed ranges quoted: ~2504-2505 ≈1.3-1.7 yr → 2 yr rounded; ~2504-2507 ≈3 yr in-universe ≈4 calendar years; ~2504-2509 ≈4.5-5 yr.

Majority of 10 colleagues explicitly give 2 years rounded up, grounding it in a 2504-2505 span for the StarCraft II opening / Kerrigan vs Mengsk phase or in a ~1.5 yr Brood War span. Minority outliers: 3 yr / 4 calendar yr for 2504-2507 Brood War, and 5 yr for 2504-2509 End War.

Unresolved/important: Blizzard/Dominion historiography does not use a single unambiguous start/end month, and “Second Great War” is used interchangeably with Brood War in fan/wikis. Need to decide which definition the question intends. Current best synthesis: canonical operational length is ~1-1.5 in-universe years, conventionally rounded up to 2 years. If inclusive calendar counting or StarCraft II-wide definition is intended, 3-5 yr arguments exist.

PRIVATE REFLECTION: The question is ambiguous because colleagues are using “Second Great War” for two different canon blocks.

* Brood-War block: most colleagues map Second Great War / Second Terran-Zerg War to the post-StarCraft I Brood War. Dates quoted are 2500-2502 / 2501-2502 / 2502-2504 with ~15-18 mo of active operations, ~1 y 6 mo elapsed → rounded up 2 y. Colleagues 1,5,7,9,13,12,4,8,11 all converge on ~1-1.5 y elapsed, calendar span 2504-2505 or 2502-2504, quoted as the conventional ~2 y rounded-up figure.
* StarCraft II block: Colleague 3 and to a degree Colleague 14 map Second Great War to the Dominion-declared war that opens with Wings of Liberty in ~2504 and closes with the End War / Legacy of the Void in ~2509, ~5 y elapsed, ~4-5 calendar years.
* Intermediate Brood War / post-Overmind block: Colleague 10,2,6,8 give 2504-2507/2504-2506/2503-2505 book-ends for the Brood War phase, ~2 y 8 m to ~3 y elapsed, i.e. ~3 calendar years, rounded up to 3-4 years. Colleague 10 explicitly cites 2504 opening → 2507 close ≈3 y in-universe, 4 calendar years inclusive.

Common points of agreement:
* The war is short in-universe, on the order of one to three years of active fighting, not decades.
* Rounding up to whole years is needed because the span crosses a year boundary.
* Dating is loose in canon; month-level start/end is not fixed, so inclusive calendar counting inflates the number.

Disagreements to track:
* What is named “Second Great War”. Brood War = Second Great War vs StarCraft II era = Second Great War.
* Start year: 2500/2501/2502/2503 vs 2504.
* End year: 2502/2504/2505/2506/2507/2509.
* Whether to report elapsed time ~1.5-2.5 y or inclusive calendar years 2504-2507/2504-2509.

Unresolved: definitive Blizzard naming and a canonical month-level start/end. Current weight of evidence and majority of colleagues points to the conventional shorthand ~1.5 y elapsed, quoted as 2 years rounded up for the Brood-War interpretation, with a strong minority pushing 3 y for 2504-2507 and 5 y for the full StarCraft II era 2504-2509.

My current belief leans to the Brood-War/StarCraft II early conflict interpretation commonly quoted as ~2504-2505, ~1-1.5 y elapsed → 2 years rounded up, while noting the 3-year and 5-year alternative framings.
